ORIGIN.quote: Likewise, cloud-looking IP prefixes and names containing `OpenAI` are corroboration, not attribution to a specific provider or model.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that OpenAI-bearing names exist in the data and that the report has considered them in the context of provider attribution, but only to declare that no attribution to a specific provider can be made — the question is raised and then closed off. It sits above 0.2 because the report explicitly frames the `OpenAI` names as bearing on provider/model attribution rather than merely listing them, and below 0.6 because OpenAI is never left standing as a live candidate operator; the only other mention ("Page names (`Agent...`, `OpenAI...`, `...SequenceCollab`) are suggestive") is used to argue automation, not origin.
